scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:assessment-db:ci: sh -c ': "${DATABASE_URL:?DATABASE_URL must point to the CI PostgreSQL database}"; export ASSESSMENT_DB_TEST_REQUIRED=true; pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push-force; pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec vitest run src/domains/assessment/__tests__/repository.db.test.ts --reporter=verbose'
